bookTitle: Cẩm Nang Chiến Thuật Làm Bài Thi Tiếng Anh Bậc 3 (4 Kỹ Năng)
publisher: Tài liệu chuẩn hóa khung năng lực ngoại ngữ Bậc 3 (CEFR B1)
chiefEditors: Hội đồng Chuyên môn Khảo thí Bậc 3
authors: Ban Biên soạn Học liệu Chuẩn B1

overview.purpose: Bài thi Đánh giá năng lực ngoại ngữ theo định hướng giao tiếp nghề nghiệp của ĐHQGHN (VNU Language Test for Occupational Purposes) đánh giá 4 kỹ năng Nghe, Nói, Đọc, Viết ở Bậc 3 (tương đương B1 CEFR) nhằm xét chuẩn đầu ra đại học và xét tuyển đào tạo thạc sỹ tại ĐHQGHN.
scoringFormula: Bài thi Đọc (40 phút - 25 câu) = (Số câu trả lời đúng / 25) × 10 (làm tròn đến 0.5)
Bài thi Nghe (~25 phút - 20 câu - nghe 2 lần) = (Số câu trả lời đúng / 20) × 10 = Số câu đúng × 0.5
Bài thi Viết (40 phút - 2 phần) = Chấm theo Thang điểm đánh giá (Task 1 chiếm 1/3, Task 2 chiếm 2/3 tổng điểm)
Bài thi Nói (8 phút/thí sinh - 2 phần) = Chấm theo Thang điểm đánh giá
Điểm kết luận = (Nghe + Đọc + Viết + Nói) / 4, lấy điểm lẻ đến 0.5
Quy định mức ĐẠT: Điểm kết luận đạt từ 6.0/10 trở lên VÀ không có kỹ năng nào dưới 2.0/10

readingGuide.title: I. KỸ NĂNG ĐỌC HIỂU (READING — 40 PHÚT / 25 CÂU)
requirements: Đọc hiểu các văn bản chứa thông tin rõ ràng về các chủ đề liên quan đến chuyên ngành, công việc và lĩnh vực quen thuộc.
Xác định các kết luận chính trong văn bản nghị luận có sử dụng các tín hiệu ngôn ngữ rõ ràng.
Tìm thấy và hiểu các thông tin liên quan trong văn bản hàng ngày như thư từ, biển báo, tờ thông tin và công văn ngắn.

subSkills.title: 1. Tiểu kỹ năng Đọc hiểu ý chính (Main Idea / Purpose)
questionTypes: What is the topic / main idea of the passage?
Which of the following would be the best title?
What is the text mainly about?
What is the purpose of the text?
steps: Bước 1: Đọc phần đầu và phần cuối của văn bản để tìm câu chủ đề (Topic sentence). Tự trả lời câu hỏi: 'Bài này viết về cái gì?' hoặc 'Mục đích bài viết là gì?'.
Bước 2: Đọc lướt toàn bộ các đoạn văn để xâu chuỗi ý chủ đạo của từng đoạn.
Bước 3: Loại bỏ các đáp án quá rộng/chung chung, đáp án chỉ nêu 1 chi tiết nhỏ trong bài, hoặc đáp án sai thái độ tác giả.

bookExample.passage:
Life is very busy these days, so we need to plan our time well. A good way to do this is to write a weekly 'to-do' list.
Write your list at the weekend. Find a quiet place and think about everything you need to do in the following week. Put the tasks into two groups: one for things you can do anytime, like buying a book or cleaning your room, and one for urgent things, like writing your essay if you have to give it to your teacher on Monday.
Choose which tasks to do on which days. Don't make your list too long; it's better to have just a few tasks for each day.
bookExample.question: Which of the following would be the best title?
options: A. Planning your time with a 'to-do' list every week
B. The best time to write a 'to-do' list
C. Tips to make your day more effective
bookExample.explanation: Câu chủ đề nằm ngay cuối đoạn 1: 'A good way to do this is to write a weekly to-do list'. Phương án B chỉ là 1 chi tiết nhỏ ở đoạn 2 (Write your list at the weekend); phương án C quá chung chung.

subSkills.title: 2. Tiểu kỹ năng Đọc hiểu thông tin chi tiết (Factual Details)
questionTypes: According to the passage, which of the following is true?
According to paragraph X, who / when / where / what / how / why...?
steps: Bước 1: Gạch chân từ khóa (keywords) trong câu hỏi và 3 phương án A, B, C.
Bước 2: Đọc dò (scan) từ trên xuống để định vị câu chứa từ khóa hoặc từ đồng nghĩa.
Bước 3: Đọc kỹ 1–2 câu xung quanh từ khóa và đối chiếu từng từ hạn định (only, often, some) để chọn đáp án đúng.

bookExample.passage: Red is a color with many meanings. It stands for fire, love, and anger. In some Asian cultures, people think red brings good luck, money, and success. When people see red, they can have different feelings. For example, people might turn red when they feel angry or embarrassed. Studies show that sports teams wearing red often win more. This is because red shows power, making the teams look stronger and more confident.
bookExample.question: The passage indicates that _____
options: A. the red color only represents good luck.
B. some people can become angry easily when they see red.
C. sports teams who wear red tend to win in sporting events.
bookExample.explanation: Hai câu cuối nêu rõ: 'Studies show that sports teams wearing red often win more' (= tend to win in sporting events). A sai vì từ 'only'; B sai vì bài nói 'turn red when they feel angry' (đỏ mặt khi tức giận) chứ không phải nhìn màu đỏ thì dễ nổi giận.

subSkills.title: 3. Tiểu kỹ năng Xác định thông tin phủ định (NOT Mentioned / EXCEPT)
questionTypes: According to the passage, which of the following is NOT true / NOT stated?
Which of the following is NOT mentioned / discussed in the passage?
All of the following are mentioned in paragraph X EXCEPT:
steps: Bước 1: Xác định từ khóa ở cả 3 phương án A, B, C.
Bước 2: Dò tìm trong bài đọc xem 2 phương án nào CÓ xuất hiện và đúng với bài đọc thì gạch bỏ.
Bước 3: Phương án còn lại chứa thông tin sai lệch hoặc hoàn toàn không được nhắc tới chính là đáp án đúng.

bookExample.passage:
In certain villages on Sardinia, an island in Italy, 91 out of 17,865 people born between 1880 and 1900 lived to be 100 years old. This is more than twice the national average.
What is their secret to living so long? Their lifestyle is a big part of it. They work hard on their farms and have strong family bonds. For instance, 75-year-old Sardinian Tonino Tola starts his day early. By 11 a.m, he has milked four cows, chopped wood, and walked 6 km with his sheep.
Diet is another key factor. Sardinians eat a lot of fruits and vegetables, dairy products, fish, and some red wine.
bookExample.question: According to the passage, which of the following is NOT mentioned?
options: A. A group of people on the island of Sardinia were 100 years old.
B. People on the island tend to work far from home.
C. Sardinians' diet is full of fruits and vegetables.
bookExample.explanation: A có ở đoạn 1 (91 người sống tới 100 tuổi); C có ở đoạn 3 (eat a lot of fruits and vegetables). Chỉ có B (work far from home) không được đề cập (họ làm việc ngay trên nông trại của mình).

subSkills.title: 4. Tiểu kỹ năng Suy luận, Đoán từ vựng ngữ cảnh & Quy chiếu (Inference, Vocabulary & Reference)
questionTypes: It can be inferred / implied from the passage that...
What does the word 'X' in paragraph Y mean? / The word 'X' is closest in meaning to...
What does the word 'This / It / They' refer to?
steps: Với câu Đoán từ vựng: Chú ý dấu phẩy (,), dấu gạch ngang (-), hoặc các từ giải thích (or, that is, such as, like, for example) đứng ngay sau từ in đậm.
Với câu Quy chiếu (It/This/They): Đọc câu liền trước và câu chứa đại từ, lắp thử danh từ đứng trước vào vị trí đại từ xem có hợp nghĩa không.
Với câu Suy luận: Tuyệt đối không chọn phương án suy diễn chủ quan hoặc dùng từ tuyệt đối (all, only) không có căn cứ trong bài.

bookExample.passage: Belle is a typical French woman who enjoys her meals with care. She starts her day with herb tea for breakfast. She loves cooking French dishes, especially 'boeuf bourguignon', a beef and red wine stew. It fills her kitchen with a delightful aroma, reminding her of family gatherings and cherished traditions.
bookExample.question: What does the word 'boeuf bourguignon' in the passage mean?
options: B. a kind of herb tea
bookExample.explanation: Ngay sau từ 'boeuf bourguignon' có dấu phẩy giải thích: ', a beef and red wine stew' (một món thịt bò hầm rượu vang đỏ). Vậy đáp án chắc chắn là C.

partsBreakdown.part: Phần 1 (Câu 1–7): Nối Biển Báo & Thông Báo Ngắn (Matching Signs & Notices)
partsBreakdown.format: 7 câu trắc nghiệm 3 lựa chọn A, B, C. Mỗi biển báo dài tối đa 20 từ; mỗi lựa chọn không quá 12 từ.
partsBreakdown.strategy: 1. Xác định ngữ cảnh của biển báo (quán cà phê, nhà ga, bể bơi, cửa hàng, thư viện). 2. Gạch chân từ khóa chỉ sự cấm đoán (No, Do not, Forbidden), điều kiện (Unless, Only, Except), hoặc ưu đãi (Free, Discount, Included). 3. Chọn phương án diễn giải đúng nghĩa nhất (paraphrase).

partsBreakdown.part: Phần 2 (Câu 8–15): Đọc Điền Từ Vào Chỗ Trống (Cloze Text — 8 Câu)
partsBreakdown.format: 1 đoạn văn ~150–180 từ có 8 chỗ trống (8)..(15), mỗi câu 3 lựa chọn A, B, C.
partsBreakdown.strategy: Đọc câu đầu tiên để nắm chủ đề và thì chính của văn bản. Xét từ đứng liền trước và liền sau chỗ trống: nếu 3 đáp án là từ hư (a/the, other/another, in/on/by, because/since/although, who/which, V-ing/to-V/V3) thì xét cấu trúc ngữ pháp; nếu 3 đáp án là danh/động/tính từ khác nghĩa thì xét ngữ cảnh và cụm từ cố định (collocation).

partsBreakdown.part: Phần 3 (Câu 16–20): Đọc Hiểu Đúng / Sai (True / False — 5 Câu)
partsBreakdown.format: 1 văn bản thông tin/tờ rơi/tiểu sử ~220–260 từ kèm 5 câu nhận định. Chọn A (True/Đúng) hoặc B (False/Sai).
partsBreakdown.strategy: Thứ tự 5 câu hỏi thường đi theo đúng trình tự văn bản từ trên xuống dưới. Gạch chân các từ khóa dễ bị bóp méo trong câu nhận định: con số, thời gian, lượng từ (all, every, only, never, more than, less than) và so sánh với câu gốc trong bài.

partsBreakdown.part: Phần 4 (Câu 21–25): Đọc Hiểu Văn Bản Dài (Multiple Choice — 5 Câu)
partsBreakdown.format: 1 bài báo/văn bản ~260–300 từ kèm 5 câu hỏi 3 lựa chọn A, B, C.
partsBreakdown.strategy: Làm các câu hỏi chi tiết, từ vựng và quy chiếu trước vì dễ định vị theo đoạn văn; làm câu hỏi Ý chính / Mục đích toàn bài hoặc câu NOT mentioned sau cùng khi đã nắm trọn nội dung.

listeningGuide.title: II. KỸ NĂNG NGHE HIỂU (LISTENING — ~25 PHÚT / 20 CÂU / NGHE 2 LẦN)
keyRules: Mỗi đoạn ghi âm trong cả 3 phần đều được phát ĐÚNG 2 LẦN.
Tận dụng tối đa khoảng thời gian dừng trước mỗi bài nghe để đọc câu hỏi và gạch chân từ khóa phân biệt 3 đáp án A, B, C.

Cảnh giác với 'bẫy phương án nhắc đến đầu tiên': cả 3 lựa chọn A, B, C thường đều được nhắc tới trong băng, nhưng đáp án đúng thường đi sau các từ chuyển hướng như: 'But...', 'Actually...', 'However...', 'No, I mean...', 'Instead of...'.

parts.partTitle: Phần 1 (Câu 1–7): Độc Thoại & Thông Báo Ngắn (Short Monologues / Messages)
parts.description: 7 câu hỏi trắc nghiệm 3 lựa chọn A, B, C tương ứng với 7 đoạn độc thoại hoặc tin nhắn thoại ngắn (~20–30 giây/đoạn) về giờ giấc, giá tiền, ngày tháng, địa điểm, thời tiết, phương tiện, món ăn...

example.question:
1. Which food does the speaker like the most? (A. Fruit and vegetables / B. Salad / C. Fried chicken)
2. When did the speaker start his music lesson? (A. 9:45 / B. 11:00 / C. 11:10)
example.transcript:
1. To stay healthy, I have a lot of fruit and vegetables in my diet because there're many kinds of vitamins in those foods. I have a salad almost every day. But I love fried chicken the most.
2. Hi Tom, it's Peter. My music lesson was just beginning when you called me at 9:45. Sorry for not answering you. I will call you back at 11:10 after the lesson finishes at 11 o'clock.
example.analysis: Câu 1 chọn C: Người nói nhắc đến 'fruit and vegetables' và 'salad' trước, nhưng sau từ 'But' mới là đáp án đúng ('But I love fried chicken the most'). Câu 2 chọn A: 9:45 là lúc buổi học bắt đầu (just beginning), còn 11:00 là lúc kết thúc và 11:10 là lúc gọi lại.

parts.description: 7 câu hỏi trắc nghiệm 3 lựa chọn A, B, C tương ứng với 7 đoạn hội thoại ngắn (~30 giây/đoạn) giữa 2 người. Kiểm tra kỹ năng nghe ý chính, chi tiết và thái độ/quan điểm của một trong hai người nói.

example.question:
1. What does the girl think about the exam? (A. It was too easy / B. It was so difficult / C. It was not like what she had revised)
2. What does the woman say about the new shop? (A. It has fashionable clothes / B. It has impressive T-shirts / C. Its clothes are not cheap)
example.transcript:
1. Girl: This was the worst exam ever! I wasn't able to finish all the questions. — Boy: Me neither.
2. Man: The new clothes shop on Knight Street is so disappointing, isn't it? — Woman: You're right. T-shirts are boring and jeans are like the ones in the 19th century. More importantly, they are all too expensive!
example.analysis: Câu 1 chọn B: 'worst exam / wasn't able to finish' đồng nghĩa với 'so difficult'. Câu 2 chọn C: 'too expensive' được paraphrase thành 'not cheap'.

parts.partTitle: Phần 3 (Câu 15–20): Hội Thoại / Độc Thoại Dài Đúng – Sai (Long Recordings — Correct / Incorrect)
parts.description: 2 bài nghe dài (mỗi bài 1–2 phút, gồm 3 câu hỏi). Thí sinh chọn A (Correct / Đúng) hoặc B (Incorrect / Sai).

example.question:
Xác định phát biểu Đúng (Correct) hay Sai (Incorrect):
1. The girl doesn't like sports at all.
2. The boy is suggesting doing charity work.
3. The girl's mother motivated her to try new things.
example.transcript:
1. Personally, I am not an active person, but I don't mind watching or playing some team sports.
2. Maybe we could raise funds for poor people in our town by selling lemonade.
3. Thanks to my mother, I could walk out of my comfort zone. She inspired me to learn about things I had never thought of before.
example.analysis: 1. Incorrect ('don't mind' khác với 'doesn't like at all'). 2. Correct ('Maybe we could raise funds for poor people' = suggesting doing charity work). 3. Correct ('inspired me to learn' = motivated her to try new things).

writingGuide.title: III. KỸ NĂNG VIẾT (WRITING — 40 PHÚT / 2 PHẦN)

task1.title: PHẦN 1 (TASK 1): VIẾT THEO GỢI Ý (TỐI THIỂU 80 TỪ — 20 PHÚT — CHIẾM 1/3 ĐIỂM)
task1.description: Thí sinh dựa vào 3–5 gợi ý cho sẵn hoặc bảng thông tin để viết một đoạn văn ngắn (tối thiểu 80 từ) tường thuật sự kiện/trải nghiệm hoặc mô tả quy trình/hồ sơ.

models.type: Dạng 1.1: Viết tường thuật / kể chuyện (Narration)
models.prompt:
Use the given prompts to write a text about a wonderful holiday experience of yours:
• Where you were
• What you did
• Why it was wonderful
Write at least 80 words.
models.sampleText: Last summer, I had a memorable two-day holiday with my family in Da Nang, Vietnam. We stayed in a hotel near My Khe beach, so it took us about five minutes to walk to the beach. On the first day, we went to the beach. I relaxed under the warm sun and enjoyed the gentle breeze. I also got some beautiful seashells when I was walking along the beach. The air was fresh, and the scenery was beautiful. On the second day, we visited ancient temples and caves and I bought souvenirs for my friends. The holiday was wonderful because it helped us relax and build stronger family relationships.
structureNotes: Câu chủ đề (Topic sentence): Last summer, I had a memorable two-day holiday with my family in Da Nang, Vietnam.
Phát triển ý 1 (Where): Stayed in a hotel near My Khe beach (5 minutes to walk).
Phát triển ý 2 (What you did): On the first day (relaxed, enjoyed the breeze, got seashells); On the second day (visited ancient temples, bought souvenirs).
Câu kết (Why it was wonderful): The holiday was wonderful because it helped us relax and build stronger family relationships.

models.type: Dạng 1.2: Viết mô tả quy trình / hướng dẫn (Process)
models.prompt:
Use the given prompts to write a text about steps to organize a party:
• choose a date, time, place
• make a guest list
• send invitations
• prepare food and drink
• enjoy the party
Write at least 80 words.
models.sampleText: Organizing a party involves several key steps to ensure everything runs smoothly. You should start by choosing a date, time, and place that suit your schedule, the number of guests and the activities of the party. Secondly, you can make a guest list to include all the people you want to invite. After finalizing the list, you should send out invitations, digitally or on paper. Your work then continues with planning and preparing food and drink and you should consider your guests' dietary preferences. Finally, on the day of the party, you may dress well, welcome your guests, interact with everyone and enjoy the party. With careful preparation, your party will be a memorable and fun experience for all.
structureNotes: Câu chủ đề: Organizing a party involves several key steps to ensure everything runs smoothly.
Các bước tiếp theo: Dùng từ nối trình tự (start by + V-ing → Secondly → After finalizing → then continues with → Finally).
Câu kết: With careful preparation, your party will be a memorable and fun experience for all.
usefulPhrases: after that / as soon as / meanwhile
vocabulary: dietary preference (n): sở thích ăn uống riêng

task2.title: PHẦN 2 (TASK 2): VIẾT ĐOẠN VĂN THEO CHỦ ĐỀ (TỐI THIỂU 100 TỪ — 20 PHÚT — CHIẾM 2/3 ĐIỂM)
task2.description: Thí sinh chọn 1 trong 2 chủ đề cho sẵn để viết một đoạn văn hoàn chỉnh (tối thiểu 100 từ) nêu Thuận lợi, Bất lợi, Nguyên nhân, Kết quả hoặc Giải pháp.

models.type: Dạng 2.1: Viết đoạn văn về Thuận lợi / Lợi ích (Advantages / Benefits)
models.prompt: Write a paragraph about the advantages of home-cooked food. Write at least 100 words.
models.sampleText: Home-cooked food offers numerous benefits. Firstly, it is generally healthier because people can select fresh food and have control over the ingredients. This allows people to maintain balanced diets which are necessary to keep fit and ensure the growth and development of children in the family. Cooking at home also helps to save money as it is often cheaper than dining out or buying pre-packaged meals. Additionally, home-cooked meals can be tailored to individual dietary needs and preferences. People can cook the food the way they prefer or choose the type of food they want. Lastly, preparing meals at home also fosters family bonds, since it encourages spending time together and sharing experiences. To sum up, home-cooked meals are beneficial for individuals and families.
usefulPhrases: This allows people to... / This is because...
To sum up, ... / Overall, ... / In conclusion, ...
vocabulary: balanced diet (n): chế độ ăn cân bằng
tailored to (adj): điều chỉnh phù hợp với
foster family bonds: gắn kết tình cảm gia đình

models.type: Dạng 2.2: Viết đoạn văn về Bất lợi / Tác hại (Disadvantages / Drawbacks)
models.prompt: Write a paragraph about the disadvantages of eating too much sugary food. Write at least 100 words.
models.sampleText: Eating too much sugary food has several disadvantages. First of all, it can lead to weight gain and obesity because sugary foods are high in calories. For example, if you eat a lot of candies and cakes, you may become overweight. Moreover, consuming a large amount of sugar can cause tooth decay which harms dental health. Besides, high-sugar diets can result in high blood sugar and blood pressures that are the risk factors for heart disease. Additionally, while a healthy diet can help improve your mood, a diet high in added sugar may contribute to changes in mood and emotions, even chances of developing depression. Overall, you should consider the drawbacks of high-sugar intake, and try to have balanced diets.
usefulPhrases: First of all, it can lead to...
Overall, you should consider the drawbacks of...
vocabulary: high-sugar intake (n): lượng tiêu thụ đường cao

models.type: Dạng 2.3: Viết đoạn văn về Nguyên nhân (Causes)
models.prompt: Write a paragraph about the causes of traffic jams in big cities. Write at least 100 words.
models.sampleText: Traffic jams in big cities are caused by a combination of factors. To start with, overpopulation leads to a big number of vehicles on the roads, causing trouble to the infrastructure. Poor urban planning, including lack of public transportation, makes the problem worse as more people rely on personal vehicles. Bad traffic management, such as poorly timed traffic lights and not enough signs, contributes to congestion. Additionally, road construction can also create traffic jams. Accidents may happen and further stop the flow of traffic. These constructions at rush hours also worsen the situation. Together, these elements create the situation of urban traffic jams.
usefulPhrases: ...are caused by a combination of factors.
because of / due to / owing to / as a result of
be caused by / result from / stem from
vocabulary: overpopulation (n): sự quá tải dân số
urban planning (n): quy hoạch đô thị
congestion (n): sự ùn tắc giao thông

models.type: Dạng 2.4: Viết đoạn văn về Kết quả / Hậu quả (Effects)
models.prompt: Write a paragraph about the effects of acid rain. Write at least 100 words.
models.sampleText: Acid rain has bad effects on the environment and human health. First, this rain greatly impacts the natural habitat of many living things. For example, it damages forests by removing nutrients from the soil and harming trees. Also, water ecosystems suffer as acid rain kills fish and other aquatic life. Another effect of acid rain can be found in its damage to human health. When acid rain is absorbed in water, it can release heavy metals like mercury and lead, entering the human food chain and causing developmental issues. Additionally, the pollutants that cause acid rain can contribute to breathing problems, including asthma and bronchitis. In short, acid rain is linked to increased risks for all living things and the natural habitat.
usefulPhrases: Another effect of... can be found in...
lead to / result in / cause / contribute to / give rise to
therefore / consequently / as a consequence / as a result
vocabulary: natural habitat (n): môi trường sống tự nhiên
aquatic life (n): sinh vật dưới nước
breathing problems (n): các vấn đề hô hấp

models.type: Dạng 2.5: Viết đoạn văn về Vấn đề & Giải pháp (Problems & Solutions)
models.prompt: Write a paragraph about the solutions to the fact that children are spending too much time watching TV. Write at least 100 words.
models.sampleText: To solve the problem of children spending too much time watching TV, several solutions can be found. First, parents can set screen time limits and encourage other activities. Activities such as reading, outdoor play, and hobbies can help physical and mental development. Likewise, schools and communities can offer after-school programs and sports. For example, a cooking class is much better than a TV session. Additionally, educational programs can raise awareness about the negative effects of TV watching and develop healthier lifestyle choices. Teachers and schools can act as powerful agents in these programs. In short, by developing a balanced routine with different activities, children can develop better habits and reduce their dependence on television for entertainment.
usefulPhrases: To solve the problem of..., several solutions can be found.
The first solution is to... / Another method is...
To combat/tackle the problem, it is important/advisable that...
vocabulary: set screen time limits: đặt giới hạn thời gian xem màn hình
after-school program (n): chương trình ngoại khóa sau giờ học
raise awareness: nâng cao nhận thức
balanced routine (n): thói quen sinh hoạt cân bằng
dependence on (n): sự phụ thuộc vào

speakingGuide.title: IV. KỸ NĂNG NÓI (SPEAKING — 8 PHÚT / 2 PHẦN)

part1.title: PHẦN 1: TƯƠNG TÁC XÃ HỘI (SOCIAL INTERACTION — 3 ĐẾN 5 CÂU HỎI)
strategy: Câu hỏi số 1 luôn là: 'Do you work or are you a student?'. Hãy nêu rõ nghề nghiệp/trường đang học + chuyên ngành + 1 chi tiết mở rộng (VD: 'I am currently a senior at University of Languages and International Studies, and my major is...').
Câu hỏi số 2 mở rộng về việc học/làm: 'Do you study/work better in the morning or in the afternoon?'. Chọn 1 buổi và giải thích lý do bằng 'because...' hoặc 'That's why...'.
Câu hỏi số 3, 4, 5 thuộc các chủ đề xã hội quen thuộc: Trả lời trực tiếp ( tránh chỉ nói Yes/No) + Mở rộng 1–2 câu bằng lý do (because, so) hoặc ví dụ (for example, such as).

qaList.q: Do you like animals? Why or why not?
qaList.a: Yes, I like animals because they are interesting and can be very friendly. They also help people in many ways, like dogs helping blind people or cats making people happy.

qaList.q: What animal do you like and why?
qaList.a: My favorite animal is the dog. Dogs are very loyal and can be good friends. They like to play and are always happy to see you. They also help people feel safe and protected.

qaList.q: Do you think it's important to protect wild animals?
qaList.a: Yes, it's important to protect wild animals because they are part of nature. If we don't protect them, some animals might disappear forever. They also keep the environment balanced and healthy.

qaList.q: What can people do to help animals?
qaList.a: People can help animals by not polluting the environment and by not cutting down forests where animals live. They can also support animal shelters and wildlife organizations.

qaList.q: Where is your hometown? What do you like most about it?
qaList.a: My hometown is Hanoi, the capital city of Vietnam. I like the Old Quarter the most because it has many historic buildings and traditional markets. The atmosphere there is very lively and interesting.

qaList.q: Is there anything you don't like about your hometown?
qaList.a: One thing I don't like is the traffic. It can be very busy and noisy, especially during rush hour.

qaList.q: Has your hometown changed much in recent years?
qaList.a: Yes, my hometown has changed a lot. There are more tall buildings, shopping malls, and new roads. It is more modern now, but some old areas are still preserved.

qaList.q: Do you think your hometown is a good place for young people?
qaList.a: Yes, I think it is a good place for young people. There are many schools, universities, and places for entertainment like cinemas, parks, and sports centers.

qaList.q: What do you do to keep fit?
qaList.a: I usually go for a jog in the morning and do some exercises at home. I also try to eat a balanced diet with lots of fruits and vegetables.

qaList.q: What kinds of food are good for health?
qaList.a: Foods that are good for health include fruits, vegetables, whole grains, and lean proteins. These foods provide essential nutrients and help keep our body strong.

qaList.q: What are some common health problems in your country?
qaList.a: Some common health problems in my country include high blood pressure, diabetes, and obesity. These issues are often related to poor diet and lack of exercise.

qaList.q: How can people improve their health?
qaList.a: People can improve their health by eating a balanced diet, exercising regularly, getting enough sleep, and avoiding bad habits like smoking and excessive drinking.

topicQuestionBanks.topic: 4. Chủ đề Giao thông vận tải (Traffic & Transportation)

qaList.q: How do you usually get around your city?
qaList.a: I usually get around my city by motorbike because it's fast and convenient. Sometimes, I also use the bus if I need to travel longer distances.

qaList.q: What do you think about the public transportation in your city?
qaList.a: The public transportation in my city is quite good. The buses are frequent and cover many areas. However, they can be crowded during rush hours.

qaList.q: What can be done to improve traffic conditions in your city?
qaList.a: To improve traffic conditions, the city can build more roads and expand public transportation options. Encouraging people to use bicycles or walk for short distances can also help.

qaList.q: What are the benefits of using public transportation?
qaList.a: The benefits of using public transportation include saving money, reducing traffic congestion, and helping the environment by lowering pollution levels.

qaList.q: What do you do to help protect the environment?
qaList.a: I use public transportation, recycle, and conserve energy at home. I also participate in community clean-up events to help keep our environment clean.

qaList.q: How can governments help protect the environment?
qaList.a: Governments can help protect the environment by giving and enforcing strict environmental regulations. They can also invest in renewable energy projects and promote sustainable development.

qaList.q: What are some environmental issues in your country?
qaList.a: Some environmental issues in my country include air and water pollution, deforestation, and loss of biodiversity, which are often caused by industrial activities and urbanization.

topicQuestionBanks.topic: 6. Chủ đề Phong tục & Truyền thống (Customs & Traditions)

qaList.q: Can you describe a traditional festival in your country?
qaList.a: One of the most famous traditional festivals in my country is the Lunar New Year, also known as Tet. It's a time for families to gather, give each other good wishes, and enjoy traditional foods like banh chung.

qaList.q: Do you think customs and traditions are important?
qaList.a: Yes, I think customs and traditions are very important. They help to keep our cultural heritage and provide a sense of identity and belonging to people.

qaList.q: What is your favorite tradition?
qaList.a: My favorite tradition is the Mid-Autumn Festival. It's a time when families gather to eat mooncakes and children carry colorful lanterns. The festival has a very joyful atmosphere.

topicQuestionBanks.topic: 7. Chủ đề Lịch sử & Âm nhạc (History & Music)

qaList.q: Do you enjoy learning about history? How do you usually learn about it?
qaList.a: Yes, I enjoy learning about history because it helps me understand how the world has changed over time. I usually learn through books, documentaries, and visiting historical sites and museums.

qaList.q: Is there a famous historical figure you admire?
qaList.a: I admire President Ho Chi Minh, the leader who played a crucial role in Vietnam's independence. His dedication and leadership are very inspiring.

qaList.q: What kind of music do you like and how often do you listen to it?
qaList.a: I like pop music and ballads because they have meaningful lyrics and beautiful melodies. I listen to music every day when commuting or doing chores because it helps me relax.

topicQuestionBanks.topic: 8. Chủ đề Gia đình, Ẩm thực & Sở thích (Family, Food & Hobbies)

qaList.q: Can you tell me about your family?
qaList.a: My family is quite small. I live with my parents and my younger sister. We are very close and often spend time together, especially on weekends.

qaList.q: Do you prefer home-cooked meals or eating out?
qaList.a: I prefer home-cooked meals because they are healthier and more affordable. However, I also enjoy eating out occasionally to try different types of cuisine.

qaList.q: What are your hobbies and why do you think having a hobby is important?
qaList.a: My hobbies include reading books, playing soccer, and cooking. Having a hobby is very important because it helps people relax, reduces stress, and provides a sense of enjoyment.

part2.title: PHẦN 2: LƯỢT NÓI DÀI CÁ NHÂN THEO CHỦ ĐỀ (INDIVIDUAL LONG TURN — 1 PHÚT CHUẨN BỊ + 2 PHÚT NÓI + CÂU HỎI PHỤ)
strategy: Thí sinh được chọn 1 trong 2 chủ đề trên thẻ nhiệm vụ (Task Card) và có 1 phút chuẩn bị nháp.
Trong 3 gợi ý trên thẻ, gợi ý số 3 ('Explain why...') là nơi dễ mở rộng nhất: hãy nêu 2–3 lý do dùng 'First..., Second..., Finally...' kèm ví dụ cá nhân để nói đủ 2 phút.
Sau khi trình bày xong, giám khảo sẽ hỏi 1–2 câu hỏi phụ (Further questions) về quan điểm, nguyên nhân, giải pháp hoặc thuận lợi/bất lợi.

modelCueCards.topicTitle: Chủ đề Mẫu 1: Describe a family member who you are closest to
prompts: Why you are closest to that person
modelCueCards.sampleSpeech: Today, I would like to describe my older sister, who I am very close to. She is my older sister, and she has always been a role model for me. She is tall and has long, brown hair. She usually wears glasses and has a friendly smile. There are many reasons why I'm closest to my sister. First, we share a lot of interests. We both love collecting stamps and listening to pop music. We can spend hours discussing these things and always have something new to learn from each other. Second, she's always been there for me. Whether I needed someone to cheer me up after a bad day or help me with a problem, she's always been a listening ear and a shoulder to cry on. Finally, she's also someone I can be myself around. We can tell each other anything without judgment, and we always have a good laugh together. In conclusion, my older sister is not only a family member but also a close friend who means a lot to me.

followUpQAs.q: What have you done to make the relationship between you and the person you are closest to stronger?
followUpQAs.a: There are a few things I've done to keep my relationship with my sister strong. Firstly, we try to spend quality time together even though we both have busy lives, like grabbing coffee or having dinner at home. Secondly, we practice active listening and give each other our full attention. Finally, we communicate openly and honestly, which builds trust.

modelCueCards.topicTitle: Chủ đề Mẫu 2: Describe a restaurant that you enjoyed going to
prompts: What type of food you ate in the restaurant
Explain why you enjoyed eating in that restaurant
modelCueCards.sampleSpeech: The restaurant I enjoyed going to was called Golden Garden and it was located in the city center. It was a Chinese restaurant that served a variety of dishes such as sweet and sour chicken, fried rice, and spring rolls. I particularly enjoyed their crispy duck with pancakes. The atmosphere in the restaurant was cozy and inviting, with traditional Chinese decorations and soft lighting. The staff were always friendly and attentive, making the dining experience pleasant. Moreover, the food was consistently delicious, with fresh ingredients and authentic flavors. Overall, I enjoyed eating at Golden Garden because of the tasty food, welcoming ambiance, and excellent service.

followUpQAs.q: What should we do when eating in a restaurant?
followUpQAs.a: As far as I know, when eating out, it's important to wait to be seated if there's a host. Then, we should be polite to the server, order politely, and wait patiently for our food. Lastly, it's nice to leave a tip or thank the staff after finishing our meal.

followUpQAs.q: What factors should we consider before deciding to open a restaurant?
followUpQAs.a: In my opinion, first of all, we must consider what customers we aim at and what kind of food people in the area like. Then, we should find a good location with lots of people walking by and parking nearby. Finally, we have to make sure we have enough budget for equipment and staff.

modelCueCards.topicTitle: Chủ đề Mẫu 3: Describe an interesting advertisement that you have seen
prompts: Where and when you saw it
Explain why you think it was an interesting advertisement
modelCueCards.sampleSpeech: I remember seeing an interesting advertisement on TV last week during a commercial break while I was watching my favorite show. The advertisement was about a new brand of energy drink called PowerBoost. It showed energetic young people participating in various outdoor activities like hiking, surfing, and cycling, while drinking the energy drink. What made it interesting was how the advertisement portrayed the product as not just a drink but as a source of vitality and adventure. The vibrant visuals and upbeat music captured my attention, and it left me feeling motivated. Overall, it was an interesting advertisement because it effectively conveyed the message of energy and excitement.

followUpQAs.q: What are the benefits of advertisements?
followUpQAs.a: In my opinion, advertisements help people know about different products and services available. Also, ads help businesses sell more things, which is good for the economy. Finally, ads can make people remember a brand.

followUpQAs.q: Do you think that advertisements make people buy things they don't really need?
followUpQAs.a: Yes, of course. Advertisements show products in a really cool and attractive way, often with famous people using them. In fact, we don't always need everything they advertise, so it's important to think carefully before buying something new.
